_comment: ARCH-002 caller audit (Part F). One entry per production function unit that contains a final-decision pattern hit. Regenerate hit counts with scripts/audit_arch002_callers.py; the script fails if any hit-bearing unit is unclassified or any classification is stale.

app.py::<module>: Threshold/label constant definitions; each consumer is classified separately.
app.py::_acoustid_fingerprint_ids: AcoustID evidence helper (ordered fingerprint recording IDs); produces evidence, decides nothing.
backend/acoustid_service.py::_acoustid_v: Playlist fingerprint status label (confirmed/mismatch/unverified) from the canonical AcoustID top tier (ACOUSTID_MIN_SCORE floor, 3-point window); non-destructive, authorizes nothing (MI-13).
app.py::_ai_auto_import_allowed: AI-confidence gate that can only narrow: requires preflight.ok, which requires canonical matching_decision.action_allowed.
app.py::_ai_batch_build_evidence: Evidence packet plumbing (threshold settings echoed for display).
app.py::_ai_batch_process_decisions: Automatic batch import only via _ai_auto_import_allowed (canonical-gated preflight).
app.py::_ai_conf_at_least: Label comparison used only as a narrowing gate over canonical preflight.
app.py::_ai_review_album_track_candidate: AI proposes keep/remove for review-state rows only; removal needs explicit item_ids and defaults to dry-run; fingerprint conflicts never reach AI.
app.py::_ai_suggest_album_internal: AI/MB candidate proposal; any automatic action goes through _ai_auto_import_allowed.
app.py::_ai_suggest_folder_internal: AI/MB candidate proposal; any automatic action goes through _ai_auto_import_allowed.
app.py::_ai_thresholds_for: Narrowing policy settings over canonical preflight.
app.py::_album_mb_match_plan: Delegates to canonical best_album_track_match with fingerprint guard; mutation via engine repair plan (canonical align_tracks_global).
app.py::_album_title_match: Album-name equivalence for folder grouping; no identity authority.
app.py::_album_track_fingerprint_check: Per-track AcoustID check returning canonical AcoustIDStatus values; evidence producer.
app.py::_apply_ai_preflight_to_suggestio: Only downgrades AI confidence from preflight results.
app.py::_candidate_track_build_compariso: Import Review comparison rows; importability is vetoed by canonical matching_decision (now enforced at evaluate_import_eligibility).
app.py::_compact_track_ai_candidate: Serializes canonical recording decision fields for the browser.
app.py::_folder_release_preflight: Invokes build_album_matching_decision; ok requires canonical action_allowed, tracklist heuristics only narrow.
app.py::_import_review_build_revalidated: is_importable vetoed by canonical matching_decision; confidence is display/narrowing.
app.py::_import_review_revalidation_conf: Display/narrowing score; never authorizes alone (canonical veto enforced).
app.py::_item_metadata_transaction_paylo: Transaction confidence metadata for a user-initiated edit.
app.py::_library_file_candidates_for_qbi: Links qBittorrent files to library rows for display metadata.
app.py::_merge_imported_album_into_exist: MIGRATED: orchestration only -- album identity and every contested slot are decided by backend/import_reconciliation.py (canonical evaluate_recording_candidate + Release Group identity); text never discards a file.
app.py::_music_format_resolve_replacemen: MIGRATED this pass: backend.recording_review.resolve_recording_identity (canonical evaluator); no remaining pattern hits.
app.py::_playlist_album_tag_release_plac: Placement authorized only by canonical.can_auto_accept(); text confidence is logged only.
app.py::_playlist_candidate_matches_trac: Playlist-entry to library-track text matching; library data is not mutated.
app.py::_playlist_canonical_placement_ev: Builds canonical evaluate_release_group_candidate evidence for placement.
app.py::_playlist_canonicalize_track: Normalizes playlist entry artist/title text from MB search; affects only the playlist manifest's requested text.
app.py::_playlist_release_looks_like_tra: Release-type ranking hint for placement candidates.
app.py::_playlist_score_download_candida: Text match feeds _audio_identity_decision only as a conflict annotation; accept/reject is canonical.
app.py::_playlist_suggestions_for_track: Documented exception: 'safe' playlist-entry suggestions rewrite only the playlist manifest's requested artist/title text (user-triggered, reversible); playlist entries are text by nature, so recording identity proof does not apply.
app.py::_resolve_album_title_duplicate_c: Provisional dedup candidate; AcoustID disagreement rejects it (Part H). FIXED this pass: NameError on undefined logger.
app.py::_resolver_title_score: Duplicate-resolver retag suggestions for manual review.
app.py::_run_ai_matching_regressions: In-product regression self-check harness; no production decisions.
app.py::_scan_album_track_integrity: Proposes remove/review candidates; /api/clean/album-tracks/remove requires explicit item_ids and defaults to dry-run.
app.py::_score_track_ai_candidate: Recording candidate ranking (_match_score is display/ranking only).
app.py::_slskd_file_wanted_match_score: Soulseek download candidate ranking; downloads are verified before import.
app.py::_source_audio_missing_track_scan: Selects files for still-missing tracks; import then passes the engine's deterministic-identity gate (reimport_source).
app.py::_track_ai_release_match_score: Linked-release ranking (release is edition evidence only).
app.py::ai_suggest: Recording candidate orchestration; every decision field comes from the canonical serializer (now given the real AcoustID hit set).
app.py::dedup_ai_review: AI-proposed duplicates; fingerprint mismatch rejects; deletion needs explicit paths or the maintenance deterministic same-album rule.
app.py::evaluate_import_eligibility: FIXED this pass (was NEEDS_MIGRATION): unattended auto-enqueue now honors the canonical matching_decision veto; the 60% confidence floor only narrows.
app.py::library_import_all: AI identification then reimport_disk (canonical preflight + engine deterministic gate).
app.py::modify_item: Transaction metadata for a user edit.
app.py::start_album_download: Review label. (ARCH-001: body moved from the route into this request-free service.)
app.py::start_dedup_scan: Provisional duplicate candidates with fingerprint veto; FIXED this pass: release_relation recorded, cross-release matches downgraded. (ARCH-001: body moved from the route into this request-free service.)
app.py::start_folder_import_with_id: Human-supplied release; library-source preflight canonical; fresh path goes to the engine confirmed-import plan (see transaction_engine entries). (ARCH-001: body moved from the route into this request-free service.)
app.py::start_playlist_download: Status message text. (ARCH-001: body moved from the route into this request-free service.)
app.py::start_reimport_disk: Mutation requires canonical preflight.ok (or explicit manual override) and the engine deterministic-identity gate. (ARCH-001: body moved from the route into this request-free service.)
backend/album_match.py::build_album_matc: Caller supplies the canonical match function.
backend/app_runtime.py::<module>: AI threshold constants moved verbatim from app.py (ARCH-001); each consumer is classified separately.
backend/duplicate_cleanup.py::verify_pai: Reviewed duplicate cleanup re-verification: requires a shared AcoustID recording, refuses an embedded Recording ID that contradicts it, then defers the decision to duplicate_identity.plan_unattended_cleanup (same slot, keeper policy, album-slot gate).
backend/duplicate_identity.py::plan_unat: Unattended duplicate deletion plan: requires fingerprint or byte proof plus the same release slot (moved here from select_unattended_cleanup_paths); keeper ranking only orders already-proven copies.
backend/duplicate_identity.py::select_un: Unattended duplicate deletion: deterministic identity or identical bytes AND same release slot (album row or release + disc/track); keeps one copy per pair.
backend/import_reconciliation.py::_side_: Serializes canonical per-side evidence (identity proof, confidence state) into review records.
backend/import_reconciliation.py::album_: ARCH-009: album identity by Release Group only; never inherited, never from Release ID.
backend/import_reconciliation.py::decide: Per-slot reconciliation outcome from canonical recording evidence; only fingerprint conflicts prove a wrong recording; text-only -> KEEP_BOTH_REVIEW.
backend/import_reconciliation.py::plan_r: Applies decide_slot outcomes; non-destructive outcomes hold both rows.
backend/matching_contract.py::build_reco: MIGRATED this pass: all decision fields from evaluate_recording_candidate.
backend/recording_review.py::audio_ident: Maps the canonical verify_audio_against_request verdict onto the file-level result schema.
backend/track_align.py::align_tracks: Delegates to canonical align_tracks_global(trust_model=fresh_reviewed_import); 0.96 only labels matched vs fuzzy for display. Unused similarity_fn documented.
backend/transaction_engine.py::_confirme: Veto-only AcoustID conflict scan for confirmed imports.
backend/transaction_engine.py::_mb_track: Veto-only: an AcoustID/title mismatch can only exclude a row from repair, never authorize one.
backend/transaction_engine.py::create_co: File-to-track mapping via track_align.align_tracks (canonical align_tracks_global); AcoustID conflicts veto. Dead _confirmed_import_title_similarity removed this pass.
helpers_mb.py::_acoustid_lookup: AcoustID provider lookup; classified canonically by consumers.
helpers_mb.py::_acoustid_parse_candidate: Parses an AcoustID response into recording candidates (extracted from _acoustid_lookup for the typed provider outcome); classified canonically by consumers.
routes_submissions.py::_describe_ytdlp_e: Per-field provenance labels for proposed submission metadata (user-confirmed).
